"$0. That's how much cash a real police officer will ever ask you to pull out of the bank.

Police in Glasgow, Kentucky, where I just was, are warning about a new one. A 'detective' calls an older person, says their bank has an inside thief, and asks them to withdraw cash. Then a fake 'FBI agent' shows up to 'check the bills for fingerprints.' The money's gone.

Two free fixes. Hang up and call your bank on the number on your card. And pick a family safe word so nobody can fake a grandkid's voice.

We have one. Does your family?"
